notes: microsoft/VibeVoice-Realtime-0.5B at revision 6bce5f06, repo commit 16fb2cb1 (the TTS code was removed from the larger VibeVoice models, only the Realtime model works). The shim wraps the repo's own streaming inference with its prebuilt voice prompts, five denoising steps, CFG 1.5. It has no cue tags and ignores speed. Very short inputs of three words or fewer are unstable. One CPU line took 36 s warm (38 s cold) on a quiet box (16 cores, nothing else rendering, 2026-10-23), so it is in both tiers.
